title: Find Nuclei analytics run manifest (v1)
description: Index of the analytics bundles produced by a single run. A run manifest is deliberately thin: it lists child bundles and shared run-level artifacts. All data semantics live in each child bundle's own manifest.json. Full specification: https://find-nuclei.github.io/docs/guides/analytics-bundle
x-stability-note: UNSTABLE: this format is published for transparency and tooling, not as a stable contract. It is still converging alongside the Find Nuclei platform and may change without preserving backward compatibility until that ships. Pin a copy rather than assuming a manifest that validates today will validate later.

version.description: Schema version. Consumers refuse majors they do not know; additive changes stay at 1.

kind.description: Discriminator separating a run manifest from a bundle manifest sharing the same filename. Absent or any other value means bundle manifest.

bundles.description: One entry per child bundle. Order drives load order; first wins on label-name collision. Consumers do not walk directories, so this listing is authoritative.

path.description: Relative subdirectory of the run containing the bundle.

targetLabel.description: Advisory. The child bundle's own target.labelName always wins.

id.description: Addressable identifier. Defaults to path when omitted.

run.description: Free-form run metadata (identifier, elapsed time, segmenter choices).

relations.description: DEPRECATED. Relationships now belong on each sub-bundle under `relationships`. Readers may ingest this as a fallback; producers should not emit it.

strictRelativePath.description: Relative path from the manifest. No leading slash and no `..` segments.

anyRelativePath.description: Relative path from the manifest. May escape the manifest directory.

producer.description: Free-form provenance. Displayed, never used for routing.

target.description: Advisory pointer at the imaged data this run was computed from.

scope.description: "image" = a single field. "plate" = an HCS plate spanning many wells and fields.

imageHint.description: Source OME-Zarr directory name. Advisory only; paths and URLs change.

plateMetadata.description: Pointers to the source plate's sidecar parquets, so consumers can enrich per-well views without re-walking the zarr. These paths routinely escape the run directory.
